DEFINE FacTar ::= LIST f, tar FROM Treatmentoutcome o has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO o has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS ai AND ALSO THE AVERAGE ai GROUPED BY f AS tar
DEFINE FacPsm ::= LIST f, psm FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO 1 / (1 + (THE SUM OF c IN Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has TreatmentbasicCrisisint c) / (THE DISTINCT COUNT OF p IN Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !f] has Patient p) + (THE SUM OF m IN Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !f] has EncounterMissappt m) / (THE DISTINCT COUNT OF q IN Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !f] has Patient q)) AS psm
LIST f, tr, pr, quad FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO f has FacTar FacTarTar t AND ALSO f has FacPsm FacPsmPsm p AND ALSO round(t, 2) AS tr AND ALSO round(p, 2) AS pr AND ALSO if(t >= 0.5, if(p >= 1 / 6, 'High Adherence, High Stability', 'High Adherence, Low Stability'), if(p >= 1 / 6, 'Low Adherence, High Stability', 'Low Adherence, Low Stability')) AS quad ORDERED WITH quad ASCENDING, f ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST pk, ak, tm, tesr, lvl FROM Encounter has Patient p AND ALSO p has PatientPatkey pk AND ALSO has Assessmentbasic a AND ALSO a has AssessmentbasicAbkey ak AND ALSO has EncounterTimeMark tm AND ALSO has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO a has AssessmentbasicSuicrisk sr AND ALSO a has AssessmentbasicDepressionPhq9Score ph AND ALSO a has AssessmentbasicAnxietyGad7Score gd AND ALSO (THE MAXIMUM v IN Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityEnvstress v) AS es AND ALSO (THE MAXIMUM w IN Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityLifeimpact w) AS li AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE sc IN (Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has Patient: !p] has TreatmentbasicEngagement e AND ALSO if(e = 'High', 3, if(e = 'Medium', 2, if(e = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS sc)) AS tes AND ALSO round(tes) AS tesr AND ALSO if(es = 'Severe', es, li) AS lvl WHERE (es = 'Severe' OR li = 'Severe') AND (sr = 'High' OR sr = 'Severe' OR ph > 15 OR gd > 15) AND tes < 2 ORDERED WITH tm DESCENDING THE FIRST 50

LIST pk, amar, sse FROM Patient p has PatientPatkey pk AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE m IN Encounter [has Patient: !p] has EncounterMissappt m) AS amar AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE sv IN (Assessmentbasic [has Patient: !p] has AssessmentbasicSocsup ss AND ALSO has AssessmentbasicRelqual rq AND ALSO (if(ss = 'Strong', 3, if(ss = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) + if(rq = 'Good', 3, if(rq = 'Fair', 2, if(rq = 'Poor', 1, 0)))) AS sv)) AS sse AND ALSO (THE COUNT OF Assessmentbasic [has Patient: !p] [has AssessmentbasicRecstatus: 'Stable']) AS nstable AND ALSO (THE SUM OF x IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has Patient: !p] has TreatmentoutcomeFuncimpv fv AND ALSO if(fv = 'Moderate' OR fv = 'Significant', 1, 0) AS x)) AS nfi WHERE nstable > 0 AND nfi > 0 AND (amar > 2 OR sse < 3)

LIST d, np, cifr FROM DISTINCT Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicPrimdx d AND ALSO (THE DISTINCT COUNT OF p IN Assessmentbasic [has AssessmentbasicPrimdx: !d] has Patient p) AS np AND ALSO (THE SUM OF c IN Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicPrimdx: !d] has TreatmentbasicCrisisint c) AS sc AND ALSO round(sc / np, 2) AS cifr ORDERED WITH cifr DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST ck, k, psmr, r FROM Clinician c has ClinicianClinkey ck AND ALSO has Facility has FacilityFackey k AND ALSO has Facility has FacilityCommunityResources cr AND ALSO 1 / (1 + (THE SUM OF ci IN Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has Patient has Clinician: !c] has TreatmentbasicCrisisint ci) / (THE COUNT OF Patient [has Clinician: !c]) + (THE SUM OF m IN Encounter [has Patient has Clinician: !c] has EncounterMissappt m) / (THE COUNT OF Patient [has Clinician: !c])) AS psm AND ALSO round(psm, 2) AS psmr AND ALSO THE RANK OF psm WITHIN k AS r WHERE cr = 'Adequate' OR cr = 'Comprehensive' ORDERED WITH k ASCENDING, r ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE PrevEng ::= LIST t, pv FROM Treatmentbasic t has Encounter has EncounterTimeMark tm AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicEngagement e AND ALSO if(e = 'High', 3, if(e = 'Medium', 2, if(e = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS es AND ALSO 1 AS g AND ALSO THE PREVIOUS es BY tm WITHIN g AS pv
LIST ch, n, ab, aa, ac FROM Treatmentbasic t has TreatmentbasicChanges ch AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicEngagement e AND ALSO if(e = 'High', 3, if(e = 'Medium', 2, if(e = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS es AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has PrevEng PrevEngPv pv AND ALSO (es - pv) AS dl AND ALSO THE COUNT OF t GROUPED BY ch AS n AND ALSO THE AVERAGE pv GROUPED BY ch AS apv AND ALSO THE AVERAGE es GROUPED BY ch AS aes AND ALSO THE AVERAGE dl GROUPED BY ch AS adl AND ALSO round(apv, 2) AS ab AND ALSO round(aes, 2) AS aa AND ALSO round(adl, 2) AS ac ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING

DEFINE FacTar ::= LIST f, tar FROM Treatmentoutcome o has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO o has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS ai AND ALSO THE AVERAGE ai GROUPED BY f AS tar
LIST f, tesr, rtir FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO f has FacTar FacTarTar tar AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE es IN (Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has TreatmentbasicEngagement e AND ALSO if(e = 'High', 3, if(e = 'Medium', 2, if(e = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS es)) AS tes AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE fs IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has TreatmentoutcomeFuncimpv v AND ALSO if(v = 'Significant', 3, if(v = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) AS fs)) * tar AS rti AND ALSO round(tes, 2) AS tesr AND ALSO round(rti, 2) AS rtir WHERE tes > 2.0 AND rti < 0.8 ORDERED WITH f ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST f, pfis, frai, rdd FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE sr IN (Assessmentbasic [is of Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has AssessmentbasicSuicrisk s AND ALSO if(s = 'High' OR s = 'Severe', 1.0, 0.0) AS sr)) * 100 AS srp AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE fi IN (Assessmentbasic [is of Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has AssessmentbasicFuncimp fv AND ALSO if(fv = 'Severe', 3, if(fv = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) AS fi)) AS pfis AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE rs IN (Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityCommunityResources cr AND ALSO if(cr = 'Comprehensive', 3, if(cr = 'Adequate', 2, 1)) AS rs)) AS frai AND ALSO (pfis - frai) AS rdd WHERE srp > 20 ORDERED WITH rdd DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE FacTar ::= LIST f, tar FROM Treatmentoutcome o has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO o has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS ai AND ALSO THE AVERAGE ai GROUPED BY f AS tar
LIST f, rddr FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO f has FacTar FacTarTar tar AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE fi IN (Assessmentbasic [is of Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has AssessmentbasicFuncimp fv AND ALSO if(fv = 'Severe', 3, if(fv = 'Moderate', 2, 1)) AS fi)) AS pfis AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE rs IN (Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityCommunityResources cr AND ALSO if(cr = 'Comprehensive', 3, if(cr = 'Adequate', 2, 1)) AS rs)) AS frai AND ALSO (pfis - frai) AS rdd AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE es IN (Treatmentbasic [has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has TreatmentbasicEngagement e AND ALSO if(e = 'High', 3, if(e = 'Medium', 2, if(e = 'Low', 1, 0))) AS es)) AS tes AND ALSO ((tes + tar * 3) / 2) AS eas AND ALSO ((THE SUM OF m IN Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !f] has EncounterMissappt m) / (THE DISTINCT COUNT OF q IN Encounter [has EncounterFacid: !f] has Patient q)) AS mar AND ALSO round(rdd, 2) AS rddr WHERE rdd > 1.0 AND eas < 1.5 AND mar > 2.5 ORDERED WITH rdd DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

LIST frai, craa FROM Facility has FacilityFackey f AND ALSO has FacilityCommunityResources cr AND ALSO if(cr = 'Comprehensive', 3, if(cr = 'Adequate', 2, 1)) AS x AND ALSO (THE AVERAGE ai IN (Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f] has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS ai)) AS y AND ALSO (THE COUNT OF Treatmentoutcome [has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid: !f]) AS nto AND ALSO 1 AS g AND ALSO 1 AS one AND ALSO (x * y) AS xy AND ALSO (x * x) AS xx AND ALSO (y * y) AS yy AND ALSO THE SUM OF one GROUPED BY g AS n AND ALSO THE SUM OF x GROUPED BY g AS sx AND ALSO THE SUM OF y GROUPED BY g AS sy AND ALSO THE SUM OF xy GROUPED BY g AS sxy AND ALSO THE SUM OF xx GROUPED BY g AS sxx AND ALSO THE SUM OF yy GROUPED BY g AS syy AND ALSO (sx / n) AS frai AND ALSO ((n * sxy - sx * sy) / (sqrt(n * sxx - sx * sx) * sqrt(n * syy - sy * sy))) AS craa WHERE nto > 0
